profile.headline: Software Engineer, Lead at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Full stack web developer with a focus on User Experience Design on a team that addresses user pain points, gathers requirements, implements technical solutions, and communicates to various stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Lead
positions.description:
PROJECT: Lifecycle Management Process – Integrated Data Environment (LCMP-IDE)
•	Supports a web application that integrates data from disparate systems and renders management tools to various government clients.
•	Works directly with client and subject matter experts to determine requirements for software releases and manages the development of features for different instance of the product.
•	Leads the Design Committee, an internal team that creates mockups, provides UX feedback, and sets design standards for all features of the web application.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Ms. Bennett worked on two prototypes for an odometer-style gauge that reflected SQL Server Perfmon data. She worked with the Mailbox Team to gather requirements and researched the best Microsoft technologies to deliver the specifications. She created a Silverlight web application, initiated the development for a Windows Sidebar Gadget, and presented her work to project managers across the Exchange group.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Ms. Bennett worked closely with the Technology Operations team to determine requirements for a server monitoring dashboard. She designed it using the graphical user interface for Microsoft SharePoint and SQL Server Reporting Services. She queried the data using T-SQL and customized the dashboard to allow for ad-hoc querying as well.
